review_scope: Prepared lesson, fictional inputs and actual outputs from source-bound regression cases, including visual review. Fixed model contributions are test-only. This is not human learner acceptance, native voice/two-window acceptance, or professional approval. Source dependency refresh after the localized advisory evidence-map repair: 35 current presentation/transcript checks pass in clara-teaching-source-refresh-02. All 60 recorded primary/supporting artifacts across these three kits are byte-identical to the previously inspected versions; the parity manifest retains actual paths. Existing editorial and visual judgments are preserved for unchanged material. No new voice, learner or GUI acceptance is asserted.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The lesson teaches requesting, reviewing and using a correction to an existing deck. A person change gives a simple visible result, and the lesson also covers how to repeat the workflow with another request.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Each locale supplies original HTML, the editable original ZIP and feedback. The learner identifies the presentation and asks to replace Sara with Elena while keeping Paolo and preserving the original.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The working chat reads feedback, checks the intended scope, edits a copy and compares the current native result. Checkpoints ask what should change before execution and ask the learner to find both the change and a preserved part afterwards.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The result is a corrected deck copy plus the interpreted request and comparison. The learner compares responsibilities and an untouched slide, reviews notes and retains the original; no delivery or publication is implied.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: Practice explicitly restarts from the original and changes only the closing slide to collect staff questions before a trial. The guide explains ordinary spoken or written feedback and identifies the additional change-plan review for PPTX without pretending the HTML exercise verifies PPTX.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Italian instructions use concrete verbs (fornire, aprire, confrontare) and the same fictional names as the slides. The proposal remains a proposal in the notes and visible closing slide. The six lesson segments total 390 seconds; the guide allows additional processing and question time. No human timed session has been observed.

demo.result_review: The responsibilities slide changes Sara to Elena and preserves Paolo. Native revision comparison passes; all original source bytes and all other slide bodies are preserved. The proposed procedure is not presented as approved. Fresh native execution produced the same HTML bytes as the visually reviewed four-viewport browser QA result.

practice.result_review: Starting from the original, the closing slide asks to collect staff questions before deciding on a trial. Sara remains on the unchanged roles slide. The actual comparison confirms the bounded edit and the original is preserved. Fresh native execution produced the same HTML bytes as the visually reviewed four-viewport browser QA result.
